title: Clean app-facing import before browser build
decision: SG-0007 should be completed as the immediate prerequisite for SG-0013. The full browser shell should be built only after the app-facing epp-full workspace has been refreshed so development-only source-files are physically removed while retained regulatory sources remain available.
context: SG-0013 will introduce service-backed browsing over the full workspace. Because the current imported workspace and import script still know about workspaces/epp-full/source-files, building the browser first would risk exposing development-only original files through navigation, metadata, download placeholders, or future service responses.
rationale: Cleaning the import boundary first makes the browser slice safer and simpler. The browser can treat the workspace as app-facing content without needing defensive UI rules around material that should not be there.
alternatives_considered: Build SG-0013 first and rely on the UI to hide source-files
Leave source-files in the workspace but omit them from navigation
Remove all source folders, including retained regulatory sources
consequences: SG-0007 is promoted to ready_to_build and becomes the recommended next item
SG-0013 is blocked by SG-0007 until the import refresh physically removes source-files from the app-facing workspace
SG-0013 validation keeps a guard that source-files are not exposed through the app
Regulatory sources under sources/regulatory remain retained inputs for CFR and Survey Guidance
